checks.finding: The nine mandatory and twenty recommended allergens and cashew/pistachio edition note agree with the lesson. The lesson limits the statement to the attached edition and requires current formal information for actual label decisions.

All 19 source table rows are represented by the grouped lesson text, preserving temperatures, inequalities, the approximate temperature for fresh produce, dry storage for grain products, and the specific cut-vegetable caveat.

The cited heating, cooling, chemical treatment and Anisakis values agree with the source: 75°C/1 minute; 85–90°C/90 seconds; 120°C/4 minutes; Anisakis 70°C or 60°C/1 minute or −20°C/24 hours; cooling 30 minutes/20°C OR 60 minutes/10°C; 200 ppm/5 minutes OR 100 ppm/10 minutes. These remain contextual learning examples. Growth-temperature and utensil-treatment clauses were not inspected.

Only paragraph 2 was compared here. Its distinction between CL and OL, recognition of workplace terminology variation, and measurement/calibration/proxy-monitoring requirements align with pages 56–57. Other paragraphs need their own cited-page checks.

The lesson uses fresh consistent arithmetic rather than repeating the source unit typo. Calculations were independently verified: 240/6=40 kg/h; 360/240=1.5 min/kg; 4×3=12 person-hours; 66/60=110%; 180/(3×2)=30 kg/person-hour; 200/(4×2)=25 kg/person-hour; 200/180≈111.1%. Page 100 supports distinguishing line and labor productivity and reporting both.
The source requires immediate stop and report for both hard and soft foreign objects. The answer and all distractor reasons agree.
The source requires prompt refrigeration or freezing of received fish and warns that histamine can increase under poor storage. All choices and reasons agree.
The source identifies solanine in potato sprouts and green peel and requires removal. The answer and distractors agree.
The source expressly forbids using moldy food. The answer and all options/reasons agree.
The source defines OL as a margin for action before CL deviation, taking measurement accuracy into account. The question remains contextual, and all four choices/reasons agree.
